g.text: Available observations, 1960-2002; calendar CPI used as an approximate deflator
Derived archival expenses with breaks | Supplementary assistance is included within categories. Inflation adjustment does not fix
eligibility, tax, reporting-period or cash/accrual changes. These are separate from modern Treasury expense totals.
Sources: MSD Statistical Report 2002, Table 7.2: selected core-benefit/pension expenses 1940-2002, including supplementary
assistance; World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL New Zealand annual history, 1960-2025
